# connbyte_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up a DNS zone at [ConnByte](https://connbyte.com/) by name or ID. Use its `id` as `zone_id` for `connbyte_dns_record`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "connbyte_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

output "zone_id" {
  value = data.connbyte_dns_zone.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Zone ID. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Zone name, for example `example.com`. Set either `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the zone (RFC 3339).
- `project_id` (String) ID of the ConnByte project the zone belongs to.
- `title` (String) Optional title of the zone.
- `updated_at` (String) Time of the last zone change (RFC 3339), empty if never changed.
